# Verification: check sent payment requests for description 'Amazon Prime Subscription'
venmo_access = globals().get('venmo_access')
if not venmo_access:
    raise Exception('Missing venmo_access')

query_str = 'Amazon Prime Subscription'
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_sent = []
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(
        access_token=venmo_access,
        query=query_str,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    print('sent_payment_requests_page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_sent.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_sent_matching_query', len(all_sent))

# Extract mapping for created ids
created_ids = [6097, 6098, 6099]
sent_by_id = {item.get('payment_request_id'): item for item in all_sent if item.get('payment_request_id') in created_ids}
print('sent_by_id_keys', sorted(sent_by_id.keys()))

for pid in created_ids:
    item = sent_by_id.get(pid)
    if item:
        print('pid', pid, 'amount', item.get('amount'), 'description', item.get('description'), 'receiver', item.get('receiver',{}).get('email'))
    else:
        print('pid', pid, 'NOT FOUND')

# Determine expected recipients: unpaid roommates were joseharr and lindseysimpson
expected_emails = {'joseharr@gmail.com', 'lindseysimpson@gmail.com'}

# Determine payment requests currently present (matching query) and amount == 35
present = []
for item in all_sent:
    if item.get('description') == 'Amazon Prime Subscription' and abs(float(item.get('amount')) - 35.0) < 1e-6:
        receiver_email = item.get('receiver',{}).get('email')
        present.append((item.get('payment_request_id'), receiver_email))

print('present_matching_amount_and_desc', present)

# Success criteria
success = True
# Should have requests for exactly Jose and Lindsey (2)
present_emails = {email for _, email in present}
if present_emails != expected_emails:
    success = False
    print('FAIL: expected emails', expected_emails, 'got', present_emails)
# Ensure Chris's payment request id 6097 is not present
if 6097 in sent_by_id:
    success = False
    print('FAIL: Chris payment_request_id 6097 still present')

print('verification_success', success)

# Complete task if success
if success:
    apis.supervisor.complete_task()
else:
    print('Task not completed due to verification failure')
